task: An authoritative native model exports to IFC and visually reopens correctly in two viewers. During export, several objects change IFC class/PredefinedType, one system relation disappears, a quantity is written as a generic property with a different unit, spatial containment changes, and some GlobalIds are regenerated. The team calls the exchange successful because geometry, colors and counts look right. Determine the exchange state and what semantic/source checks are required before the IFC can be used as a governed downstream information model.
pass_rule: Separates geometry from semantic fidelity, keeps the native source authoritative, records schema/view/export configuration, builds source→IFC mapping evidence for classes/relations/properties/quantities/units/identity, performs downstream deterministic and visual readback, records known losses and refuses governed semantic-use claims until requirement-scoped drift is corrected or explicitly accepted.
central_golden_note: Current AI Governance validation directly loads evals/golden/skills.jsonl. This local spec must not be described as CI-executed until a controlled no-loss central Golden integration is completed.
